protocol: No preliminary oxygen prebreathe. Oxygen from chamber ascent onward. Six-hour target protocol with 40 minutes work and 20 minutes rest per cycle. Work energy expenditure reported as 400–450 kcal/h by indirect calorimetry.
outcome_window: The report describes continuous examination during the test and 24-hour hospitalization for affected volunteers. Fixed surveillance for event-free volunteers after descent is unspecified.
note: Results give 0.4 atm and 308 mm Hg as ambient pressure. Methods p. 112 labels 0.3 atm as suit excess pressure. Both cases were mild. Printed 0.41% differs from 2/434 (0.46% when rounded to two decimals). NASA TM-76015 p. 6 (PDF p. 9) repeats 2/434 at 0.4 atm and prints 0.46%.

protocol: A six- to eight-hour initial stage at 553 mm Hg with nominal 40% oxygen and 60% nitrogen in the Methods, followed by the 248 mm Hg final stage breathing pure oxygen. Six trials lasted two to three hours and 14 lasted five to six hours at the target.
outcome_window: Symptoms during the reported final exposure. Fixed postdescent follow-up is unspecified.
note: No HADD symptoms in 20 tests involving 16 people. Result spans JPRS pp. 73–74. The Methods give 248 mm Hg at the target and the conclusions use 250 mm Hg.

protocol: Eight hours at the preliminary 2.6 km stage, with a nominal 40% oxygen and 60% nitrogen mixture, then pure oxygen during ascent and the nominal 180 mm Hg final chamber stage. Three-hour target exposure in the protocol.
outcome_window: Symptoms during the reported final exposure. Fixed postdescent follow-up is unspecified.
note: The Results identify 15 fully executed tests at 10.6 km without HADD symptoms. This is a completion subset within the 18-experiment series.

protocol: Eight hours at 550 mm Hg breathing nominal 40% oxygen and 60% nitrogen, then three hours wearing a 180 mm Hg pressurized suit in a chamber at 2 mm Hg.
outcome_window: Symptoms during the reported final exposure. Fixed postdescent follow-up is unspecified.
note: The p. 75 methods identify two suited tests. P. 76 explicitly reports no HADD symptoms in the suited tests and summarizes 17 experiments. The individual crosswalk to the series is unavailable.

protocol: Eight hours at the preliminary 2.6 km stage, with a nominal 40% oxygen and 60% nitrogen mixture, then pure oxygen during ascent and the nominal 180 mm Hg final chamber stage. Three-hour target exposure in the protocol.
outcome_window: Began immediately on reaching the target in a selected altered trial.
note: Poor tolerance resolved at higher pressure and recurred on re-ascent within the same experiment. The source identifies meteorism and describes a later repeat trial without it. The observation is one described episode, with no comparable risk set assigned.

protocol: Repeated human chamber experiments at 11–12 km on oxygen after heterogeneous 20-minute to four-hour desaturation. Target time was typically two to three hours, ranging up to 24 hours in the longer tests.
outcome_window: Examination before, during and after chamber ascent. Affected individuals were hospitalized as indicated. Fixed surveillance duration across the full series is unspecified.
note: Ten experiments with minor functional findings such as fatigue, headache, tremor and autonomic changes. Source-defined neurological observation with heterogeneous clinical findings.
